labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Reports a broken link in CONTRIBUTING.md (AI_POLICY.md link points to master); the rest is a contribution-process question covered by the comment.

items.body:
The AI_POLICY.md link in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) points to the `master` branch, so this is a documentation report. A maintainer will check the link.

Pull requests are limited to collaborators. Contributors describe the change in an issue first, so this report is the right place for it. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) for the process. Related: #4203.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
